evaluation.protocol: stratified train/validation/test evaluation; best epoch selected on validation, model refitted on train plus validation, and final metrics measured once on untouched test data

baseline_threshold_calibration.protocol: 5-fold stratified balanced-threshold validation on labelled MVTec test images; production threshold maximizes sensitivity plus specificity on all labelled images

openvino_spatial_calibration.protocol: nested stratified cross-validation on labelled MVTec test images; each outer fold performs calibrator and threshold selection using only its training partition; production calibrator is fitted on all labelled images after evaluation
